chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Hassan from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Husayn from Ali ibn Abdullah from Yazeed ibn Is'haq from Harun ibn Kharajah from Al-Mufaddal from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said:
There is nothing with which Allah is worshipped on the day of Friday that is more beloved to me than sending blessings upon Muhammad and the Progeny of Muhammad.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: Blessings / Supplication (specifically sending blessings upon the Prophet)

ai.seo_question: What is the most beloved act of worship to the Imams on Friday?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies sending blessings upon the Prophet and his Progeny as the most beloved act of worship on Friday, elevating it beyond mere ritual to a means of spiritual connection with the Ahl al-Bayt. This tradition underscores the unique status of Friday in Shia jurisprudence as a day of heightened devotion, where Salawat serves as a bridge between the believer and the divine light of the Imams.
